title: Register Account
requirement: A guest creates a customer account with a full name and either an email or a phone number, without a password, and confirms it with one one-time code (includes Verify OTP). After registering, the customer is signed in and lands on the Customer Dashboard; the other email or phone number can be added later with Change Email or Phone Number.
guard: verify REGISTER OTP and approved policy consents
effect: create CUSTOMER + verified contact + session atomically
alternative: duplicate verified contact -> 409; invalid DTO -> 422

title: Log In
requirement: A registered user enters a confirmed email or phone number and the code sent to it (includes Verify OTP) and reaches the dashboard of his or her role. The user stays signed in for 30 days (Customer, Pet Sitter) or 12 hours (Staff, Sale Staff, Admin). A locked Customer, Staff or Sale Staff account cannot sign in; a suspended pet sitter can still sign in but gets no new visits.
guard: consume valid LOGIN OTP; reload current account
effect: issue opaque session only for ACTIVE allowed account
alternative: locked account -> 403 after valid OTP; never issue session

title: Log Out
requirement: A signed-in user ends the session from the header and returns to the home page.
guard: authenticate owned session
effect: revoke session; clear pwc_session cookie
alternative: expired/missing session cannot revoke another user

title: Change Email or Phone Number
requirement: A signed-in user adds the email or phone number that the account does not have yet, or changes one, and confirms the new value with a code (includes Verify OTP). A user who has lost the only confirmed one is helped by an Admin after an identity check.
guard: verify new contact with purpose/session binding
effect: replace verified contact under unique lookup and audit
alternative: wrong contact/purpose -> reject; lost sole channel needs verified support

title: Verify OTP
requirement: The system sends a 6-digit code to the email or phone number and checks the code the user types. Included by Register Account, Log In and Change Email or Phone Number. A code is valid for 5 minutes and can be sent again after 60 seconds, at most 5 codes an hour; five wrong codes block that email or phone number for 15 minutes.
guard: validate challenge expiry, attempts, purpose and contact
effect: consume once; dispatch verified purpose handler
alternative: expired/wrong/replayed code -> no account or session

title: View Home Page
requirement: A guest or customer sees the introduction of the Paw World shop (food, accessories, bathing and grooming) and its home care services, with links to the products, the services and booking.
guard: Public read; use server effective time, catalog enabled gate and published current versions
effect: 200 {available,services} with scope/species/published policy/current price and presentation
alternative: Invalid price contract -> 503 CATALOG_INTEGRATION_PENDING; disabled catalog -> available:false; invalid client DTO -> INVALID_RESPONSE No AI pricing. Starting/catalog price is not a confirmed booking quote. Home static introduction/navigation is rendered locally; HomeProductPreview independently reads products. Loading the home page does not create a booking or cart.

title: View Service List
requirement: A guest or customer sees the shop's bathing and grooming services and the home care services (home visits, dog walking and vet accompaniment) with their starting prices.
guard: Public read; use server effective time, catalog enabled gate and published current versions
effect: 200 {available,services} with scope/species/published policy/current price and presentation
alternative: Invalid price contract -> 503 CATALOG_INTEGRATION_PENDING; disabled catalog -> available:false; invalid client DTO -> INVALID_RESPONSE No AI pricing. Starting/catalog price is not a confirmed booking quote.

title: View Service Details
requirement: A guest or customer sees what a service includes, its limits, the price table and surcharges.
guard: Public read; use server effective time, catalog enabled gate and published current versions
effect: 200 {available,services} with scope/species/published policy/current price and presentation
alternative: Invalid price contract -> 503 CATALOG_INTEGRATION_PENDING; disabled catalog -> available:false; invalid client DTO -> INVALID_RESPONSE No AI pricing. Starting/catalog price is not a confirmed booking quote. ServiceDetailsPage loads GET /services and selects serviceId in the returned catalog; no separate backend service-detail GET is invented. Missing ID gives the client not-found state. Supplements/final quote require the separate deterministic quote flow.

title: View Service Areas and Policies
requirement: A guest or customer sees the service areas (groups of wards and communes), the cancellation and refund policies and the responsibility policy: what Paw World covers, what it does not cover and what the customer must do.
guard: Read enabled public coverage catalog and current published service-policy versions independently
effect: Render public areas and effective service policy text; unavailable source has its own empty/pending state
alternative: Do not invent approved cancellation/refund/liability policy; map pin does not establish coverage

title: Manage User Accounts
feature: FE-03 User Accounts and Customer Profiles
requirement: The Admin searches and filters the accounts of every role, opens an account to see its details, creates accounts for new Staff and Sale Staff members (name, email and phone number; they sign in with a one-time code), corrects the full name of a pet sitter, a Staff or a Sale Staff member, who cannot change it themselves, and locks or unlocks Customer, Staff and Sale Staff accounts with a reason. A customer account with bookings or orders that are not finished cannot be locked. Roles cannot be changed: a role comes from the way the account was created.
guard: ADMIN route and exact action/role body; target nonsynthetic user and expectedVersion; self-role edit forbidden
effect: LOCK/UNLOCK or distinct allowed role change atomically updates state/roles and authEpoch/version, revokes target sessions and writes audit
alternative: Only CUSTOMER/PET_SITTER/STAFF/ADMIN exist; PET_SITTER membership changes remain application-managed. No command replay store; stale/version/role conflict returns explicit error

title: Update Customer Profile
feature: FE-03 User Accounts and Customer Profiles
requirement: The customer updates his or her full name and one emergency contact (name, phone number and relationship), and sees his or her tier (Member, Silver or Gold) and its discount. The email and the phone number are added or changed with Change Email or Phone Number.
guard: Active CUSTOMER identity, allowlisted displayName/expectedVersion and current owned user version
effect: Read masked profile; normalize and CAS name only when different; reload authoritative profile projection
alternative: No stored key replay or contact mutation. Stale version -> PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT, missing ->404, invalid fields ->422, private decrypt failure ->503

title: Manage Service Addresses
feature: FE-03 User Accounts and Customer Profiles
requirement: The customer adds, edits and removes service addresses with home access notes. The customer picks the ward or commune, so the system knows the service area. Among pet sitters, only the pet sitter of a visit sees the access notes (View Home Access Notes); Staff see them only while handling that visit. An address outside every service area can be saved but is marked Not served and cannot be chosen for a booking. A booking keeps a copy of its address, so later edits do not change it. An address used by a booking that is not finished cannot be removed.
guard: Owned CUSTOMER scope; explicit map pin, finite GeoJSON lon/lat, configured coverage area, label/location and bounded private notes; exact action input/version/key
effect: Separate scoped read and guarded resource command; save current data and command result atomically; archive checks unfinished references before commit
alternative: Wrong/changed active record -> conflict, invalid data ->422; archive of referenced unfinished visit rolls back. Address lookup and avatar uploads remain separate; booked snapshots are preserved

title: View Pet List
requirement: The customer sees his or her dogs and cats and removes a pet that is no longer cared for. A pet in a booking that is not finished cannot be removed.
guard: Current CUSTOMER session; derive ownerId from session, never query parameter
effect: 200 bounded petView[]
alternative: No session ->401; non-Customer ->403; source read failure -> safe error Pet removal is the separate POST /pets/:id/archives command with CSRF/key/state/version guards; it is not a GET side effect.

title: Add Pet Profile
requirement: The customer adds a dog or a cat with its name (required), breed, weight, temperament, habits, feeding and care needs, vaccination status (last date; complete, not complete or unknown; an optional photo of the vaccination book) and photos. Pet sitters see the profile with each offer and visit; the vaccination status does not block a booking.
guard: Owned CUSTOMER scope; DOG/CAT, name/breed/species/weight/traits and declared care fields; verify active breed/trait catalog and preserve UNKNOWN as unknown; exact action input/version/key
effect: Separate scoped read and guarded resource command; save current data and command result atomically; archive checks unfinished references before commit
alternative: Wrong/changed active record -> conflict, invalid data ->422; archive of referenced unfinished visit rolls back. Address lookup and avatar uploads remain separate; booked snapshots are preserved

title: Update Pet Profile
requirement: The customer changes the details, care needs or photos of a pet. Visits that already have a pet sitter keep the confirmed instructions until the customer confirms the new version for them (see Confirm Care Instructions).
guard: Owned CUSTOMER scope; DOG/CAT, name/breed/species/weight/traits and declared care fields; verify active breed/trait catalog and preserve UNKNOWN as unknown; exact action input/version/key
effect: Separate scoped read and guarded resource command; save current data and command result atomically; archive checks unfinished references before commit
alternative: Wrong/changed active record -> conflict, invalid data ->422; archive of referenced unfinished visit rolls back. Address lookup and avatar uploads remain separate; booked snapshots are preserved

title: Submit Sitter Application
feature: FE-05 Pet Sitter Recruitment and Management
requirement: A guest who wants to become a pet sitter fills in the application without an account: full name, date of birth, phone number and email (both required), ID card number, service areas, experience, ID card photos, a portrait photo and certificates if any. The system checks that the person is at least 18 years old and has no Pending application with the same phone number, email or ID card, saves the application as Pending and emails a receipt with the application code.
guard: validate age/verified contact/consents/owned private documents
effect: create PENDING application + audit + durable mail intent
alternative: duplicate pending/reapply cooldown; mail failure preserves application

title: View Sitter Applications
feature: FE-05 Pet Sitter Recruitment and Management
requirement: The Admin lists pending, approved and rejected applications.
guard: Admin only; allowlisted state/employmentType/search and page bound; cursor bound to filter fingerprint
effect: 200 applications with masked contact, safe fields, summary,totalMatching,nextCursor
alternative: 401/403 authorization; invalid filters/cursor ->422; no private document read or detail-audit write from this list

title: Approve or Reject Sitter Application
feature: FE-05 Pet Sitter Recruitment and Management
requirement: The Admin checks the application against a checklist (valid ID card, at least 18 years old, portrait photo, experience with pets) and calls the applicant for an interview. Approval creates an active pet sitter account from the phone number and email of the application and emails a welcome message. Rejection needs a reason from a list (for example Could not be reached); the email gives the reason and the date from which the person can apply again (30 days later).
guard: Current ADMIN and action/version/key; stage transitions are PENDING->UNDER_REVIEW->INTERVIEW, final decision requires INTERVIEW
effect: APPROVE verifies owned contact/account and signed latest contract then atomically promotes user, activates contract/status and commits application/audit/mail/notifications; REJECT separately records reason and reapply window
alternative: Exact scoped audit replay returns prior result; changed payload, earlier stage, stale app, invalid contact/account or unsigned contract rejects without partial promotion

title: Suspend or Reinstate Pet Sitter
feature: FE-05 Pet Sitter Recruitment and Management
requirement: The Admin suspends an approved pet sitter with a reason, so the pet sitter gets no new visits and pending offers are withdrawn. A pet sitter in the middle of a visit finishes it first. Visits the pet sitter has already accepted are offered automatically to other pet sitters and flagged for handover. The Admin can reinstate the pet sitter later, with a note.
guard: ADMIN and APPROVED application/provisioned user, scoped audit key/fingerprint and current SitterStatus version
effect: CAS ACTIVE<->SUSPENDED with reason/time and audit/result in one transaction; later authoritative eligibility reads the new status
alternative: Missing/not-approved/stale status or changed key payload fails explicitly. Source does not automatically remove role, cancel visits, reassign or deduct payroll

title: View Sitter Earnings
feature: FE-05 Pet Sitter Recruitment and Management
requirement: The pet sitter sees, for each booking or groomed pet, the work he or she finished with the visit pay (part-time), the difficulty bonus and the tips paid through PWC (shared equally among the pet sitters who did the work); the Admin sees the same for every pet sitter. The pay of each period is on the pay statement (Review Pay Statement). Paw World pays pet sitters outside the system.
guard: PET_SITTER session; scope userId=targetId=actor; validate dates/limit/cursor and financial policy gate
effect: 200 source-backed PAGE earnings subtotals/items or 202 INTEGRATION_PENDING
alternative: 401/403/422 for session/role/filter; invalid source/ledger ->503; missing/undecided source ->202, never guessed pay/tips This legacy per-source read is separate from employee PayrollService.own and approved FT/PT salaries; it does not calculate new compensation, equal tip split or execute external payout.

title: Manage Pet Sitter Contracts
feature: FE-05 Pet Sitter Recruitment and Management
requirement: The Admin records the contract of each pet sitter: full-time (monthly pay, fixed shifts) or part-time (pay for each visit), with start and end dates. Paw World pays outside the system.
guard: Each request requires current Admin/session/CSRF and its own payload-bound operation key. Save requires INTERVIEW stage, matching identity, applicationVersion and expectedRevision
effect: Separate save creates DRAFT; separate ISSUE checks latest DRAFT/hash/version and marks ISSUED; separate SIGN records real both-party/archive/date evidence and marks SIGNED. A later application APPROVE transaction promotes the eligible account, calls activate with the same session, creates the contract/status and commits application/audit/mail intent together
alternative: Each request replays only its own same-key/payload outcome; stale revision/hash/state or missing signed contract returns conflict and approval rollback. No signature is fabricated

title: Manage Services
requirement: The Admin creates, updates and deactivates home care services and shop grooming services, including the checklist of tasks. A deactivated service cannot be booked any more, but bookings already made keep their price and terms.
guard: Admin route, allowed service fields and expected latest version
effect: Create identity/first version or append new immutable service revision plus audit in a transaction
alternative: Duplicate code/effective revision or stale version ->409; nonbookable current state prevents new booking while historical snapshots remain unchanged

title: Configure Service Prices
requirement: The Admin sets base prices, surcharges for pet size and extra pets, travel surcharges by service area, discounts for bookings with many visits (for example 5% from 7 visits, 10% from 20 visits) and the shipping fee of product orders by service area. A booking or an order keeps the prices that applied when it was made.
guard: ADMIN route, actual service, safe integer VND, valid effective timestamp and expected price version
effect: Append immutable base price + audit atomically; quotes use separate approved deterministic policy versions
alternative: Stale/duplicate revision ->409; missing price or approved rule blocks quote. Older SRS discount examples do not replace approved current policy

title: Configure Booking Policies
requirement: The Admin sets the service areas (groups of wards and communes), the responsibility policy shown to customers, the minimum booking notice (24 hours), the longest booking (30 days), the free cancellation window (24 hours), the late cancellation fee (30% of the visit price), the payment deadline (48 hours), the refund rules, the travel time needed between two visits, the answer time for offers and how late a pet sitter may withdraw from a visit, and for the shop the refusal limit for cash on delivery, the payment deadline of prepaid orders, the pick-up deadline and the time to report a faulty product.
guard: ADMIN visibility/service-policy input and expected immutable revision; public policy reads enforce approval/source/hash/effective gates
effect: Separate visibility revision and service-policy revision transactions append audits; public catalog reads approved versions only
alternative: Full SRS booking/cancellation/refund/liability configuration remains partial; no old unapproved percentage/deadline is silently enabled

title: Create Booking
requirement: The customer chooses a service, the pets it is for, the address, the dates and one or two visit times a day, and the care needs, answers short questions about each pet's behaviour and health, sees the final price, including any discount for many visits and the tier discount, checks the care instructions filled in from the pet profiles, accepts the responsibility policy and confirms. The customer can ask for a preferred pet sitter who has cared for the pet before, who is offered the visits first; a pet sitter cannot be chosen by name. A booking must be made at least 24 hours ahead and can last at most 30 days. It is confirmed when it is placed and paid after the visits; its visits are offered to pet sitters automatically. A customer with an overdue payment cannot book; a customer with no paid bill yet can book at most 7 days and have only one unpaid booking; two bookings of one pet cannot overlap. Each visit time on each date becomes a separate visit.
guard: validate owner-bound nonexpired QUOTE/MATCH and schedule feasibility
effect: transaction: booking + visit snapshots + intent + idempotency/outbox
alternative: pet-time overlap/stale quote -> 409; PREPAY deadline 15 min

title: View My Bookings
requirement: The customer lists his or her bookings by status.
guard: ACTIVE CUSTOMER; only limit/cursor accepted, limit1..50; enabled and bookings collection provisioned
effect: 200 owned booking summaries + nextCursor; expired AWAITING_PAYMENT projected PAYMENT_EXPIRED
alternative: 401/403/422; disabled/unprovisioned source ->503 BOOKING_READ_UNAVAILABLE; malformed state ->503 INVALID_PROJECTION State filter from SRS is not currently accepted by this list API; expiry projection does not persist a new booking state.

title: View Booking Details
requirement: The customer opens a booking to see its terms, assigned pet sitters, payments and reports.
guard: Current CUSTOMER; valid id and owned booking; source storage ready
effect: 200 booking/payment summary, visits, careShifts and scheduleProposals
alternative: 401/403/422; ownership/missing resource ->404; source not ready ->503 Customer booking detail is a read only. Stored payment amount/state is not proof of a new provider payment.

title: View Visit Schedule
requirement: The customer sees all visits of a booking, each with its own time window, pet sitter and status.
guard: Current CUSTOMER; valid id and owned booking; source storage ready
effect: 200 booking/payment summary, visits, careShifts and scheduleProposals
alternative: 401/403/422; ownership/missing resource ->404; source not ready ->503 Customer booking detail is a read only. Stored payment amount/state is not proof of a new provider payment. Customer visit snapshots and operational care shifts are distinct arrays; do not substitute one for another.

title: Set Working Hours
requirement: A part-time pet sitter keeps his or her weekly working hours; a full-time pet sitter sees the shifts of the contract (Manage Shift Schedule) and does not set hours. Every pet sitter chooses his or her service areas; an Admin can change the service areas of a pet sitter. If a change affects visits the pet sitter has already accepted, those visits are flagged to Staff.
guard: PET_SITTER ownership, current ACTIVE employee/status guard, future effective windows/area input, signed contract and availability version
effect: Separate read/calendar and command: conflict-check confirmed visits, CAS availability, persist effective revision plus scoped command/event in same transaction
alternative: Invalid/overlap/backdated input, contract gap, lost assigned coverage or stale version rejects; exact stored command may replay. FT40/PT20 contract terms are not inferred attendance or payroll

title: View Unassigned Visits
requirement: The Staff member sees each visit waiting for a pet sitter with the state of its automatic offers, ordered by start time, and a Needs action list: visits the automatic offers could not fill (nobody accepted), visits still without a pet sitter 24 hours before they start, visits whose pet sitter has not checked in 30 minutes after the start, withdrawals less than 12 hours before a visit, visits affected by a pet sitter's change of working hours, visits not checked out 2 hours after their end, handovers not confirmed 1 hour before the visit, and the bookings of a customer with an overdue bill, so the Staff member can call the customer. A visit closed by the Staff member without check-out counts as done only if it has a check-in photo; otherwise it is cancelled at no charge and the pet sitter is not paid.
guard: Current STAFF/ADMIN session; source storage must be available; GET never calls invite/runBatch
effect: 200 {items,queueHasMore,workAreas,today} with dispatchState/deadline/reviewCode and late flags
alternative: 401/403 access; source failure ->safe error; no expired invitation auto-write in this read The full SRS Needs action catalog and corrective close/cancel/reassign commands are separate requirements; this query shows only source-backed queue/today fields. No fictional unpaid/late escalation record is created.

title: Assign Sitter to Visit
requirement: For a visit in the Needs action list, the Staff member opens the planning board, sees the free pet sitters ranked with reasons (the same ranking as the automatic offers) and gives the visit to one by hand, after calling him or her if needed. A pet sitter with an overlapping visit cannot be chosen; outside working hours or outside the pet sitter's service areas the system shows a warning and the Staff member confirms. If a pet sitter accepts an automatic offer for the same visit, or another Staff member assigns it, at the same moment, the first one saved keeps the visit and the Staff member who saved later is told.
guard: Staff/Admin current context, future SCHEDULED approved care plan/payment, manual dispatchReview and employee eligibility/version/key
effect: Atomically create bounded PENDING invitations/events/result; actual assignment is UC-35 acceptance with its own recheck
alternative: AI preview never assigns; manual bypass before system exhaustion or ineligible/occupied/stale selection fails; do not invent override of hard eligibility

title: View All Bookings
requirement: The Staff member searches all bookings by customer, date and status and opens a booking to see its visits, pet sitters and payments.
guard: STAFF/ADMIN session; customer/date/status filters and bounded signed cursor; approved operational visibility
effect: Proposed booking page/detail DTO + scoped cursor
alternative: Missing source/route -> integration pending; invalid filter/access -> safe422/403; never reuse CUSTOMER-only checkout read for Staff Current source readers are Customer-owned, not the full Staff all-booking search. Implement/mount this reader before claiming runtime coverage.

title: Monitor Today's Visits
requirement: The Staff member sees all of today's visits with their live status: waiting for a pet sitter, assigned, arrived, in progress, finished. Visits where the pet sitter has not checked in 15 minutes after the start are shown in red and the Staff member calls the pet sitter; at 30 minutes the visit goes to Needs action, and the Staff member sends another pet sitter or cancels the visit at no charge. The customer's live card says that the pet sitter is late.
guard: Current STAFF/ADMIN session; source storage must be available; GET never calls invite/runBatch
effect: 200 {items,queueHasMore,workAreas,today} with dispatchState/deadline/reviewCode and late flags
alternative: 401/403 access; source failure ->safe error; no expired invitation auto-write in this read The full SRS Needs action catalog and corrective close/cancel/reassign commands are separate requirements; this query shows only source-backed queue/today fields. No fictional unpaid/late escalation record is created.

title: View My Assignments
requirement: The pet sitter sees the visits offered to him or her and the visits already accepted, with today's visits in the planned order (JOB-06).
guard: ACTIVE PET_SITTER; limit1..50; allowlisted state/cursor; derive sitterId from actor
effect: 200 separate offer and assignment pages with nextCursor
alternative: 401/403/422; source scope/shape invalid ->503; unsafe or inaccessible offer ->404 Source pagination order is _id descending; JOB-06 route planning is not implemented and is not implied by displaying assignments.

title: Accept or Decline Visit Offer
requirement: The pet sitter accepts or declines an offered visit within the answer time (2 hours, or 30 minutes for a visit that starts within 24 hours); declining needs a reason. A declined or unanswered offer is passed automatically to the next pet sitter on the list. A full-time pet sitter is offered only visits inside his or her shifts. If Staff assign the visit by hand at the same moment, or the visit is no longer free, the first one saved keeps it and the pet sitter is told the visit is taken.
guard: Active owned PET_SITTER offer; command replay guard; read current PENDING offer/deadline/version before deciding
effect: DECLINE CAS records refusal and reopens dispatch context; ACCEPT separately checks booking/payment/directed identity and eligibility/occupancy, CAS assigns visit, revokes rivals and commits events/result
alternative: Same-key exact replay only through EmployeeDispatch command; changed payload or stale/expired/occupied/unpaid visit -> conflict and rollback; AI never assigns directly

title: View Visit Details
requirement: The pet sitter opens an offered or accepted visit to see the pet profile, the confirmed care instructions and the address. The home access notes are shown in the same screen under the rules of View Home Access Notes.
guard: PET_SITTER session; offered record scoped to sitter; care requires assigned active visit and allowed parent booking
effect: 200 safe assignment detail / current confirmed care snapshot and access time bounds
alternative: 401/403; inaccessible or inactive assignment ->404; handover missing ->403; legacy care snapshot ->503 Current offered/assigned reads are distinct. Legacy SitterVisitService.detail requires an injected repository and does not expose private address. Home access notes use a separate time-window read, never unconditional disclosure to an offered sitter.

title: View Home Access Notes
requirement: The pet sitter of a visit sees the home access notes of its address (gate code, where the key is) from 1 hour before the visit until check-out. A replacement pet sitter sees them only after confirming the handover. Extends View Visit Details.
guard: Current assigned active visit/booking, accepted handover if required, care schema1, one-hour-before/endAt window and current sitter-bound care hash acknowledgement
effect: Read only privateAccessNotes from immutable checkout care snapshot; return expiresAt without source rewrite or access-note audit write
alternative: Wrong assignment/state ->404; handover/time/acknowledgement denial ->403; missing care snapshot503. Current endAt window and absent read audit remain SRS/design gaps

title: Reassign Sitter
requirement: The Staff member replaces the pet sitter of a visit. The customer and both pet sitters are notified, and the new pet sitter must confirm the handover.
guard: Staff/Admin, ASSIGNED current version/future visit, different eligible nonsuspended replacement and free slot
effect: Domain port calls guarded reassignVisit, requires version+1 and handover, appends audit/outbox/notifications; schedule and payout unchanged
alternative: Runtime repository/composition is a release gate; stale/started/suspended/occupied rejects, missing port returns unavailable

title: Cancel Booking or Visit
requirement: The customer cancels a booking or a single visit. A visit cancelled 24 hours or more before it starts costs nothing; a later cancellation adds a late cancellation fee (30% of that visit's price) to the bill. The Staff member cancels, without any charge, a visit that still has no pet sitter 12 hours before it or whose pet sitter has not arrived 30 minutes after the start.
guard: Proposed current owner/operational authorization, uncancelled aggregate version and approved effective cancellation policy
effect: Proposed replayable aggregate transaction cancels eligible visits/invitations and records deterministic policy-bound decisions/audit/notification; financial reconciliation remains separate
alternative: Missing approved policy blocks financial effect; stale state or conflicting command rolls back; no auto-success refund or unapproved 30% fee

title: Confirm Care Instructions
requirement: The customer confirms the care instructions for each visit, and the visit keeps the confirmed version. Instructions can be changed until 2 hours before a visit; later changes apply from the next visit. If the customer changes the instructions after a pet sitter is assigned, the pet sitter is notified and must confirm reading the new version before checking in.
guard: Customer owner, active session, normalized allowed instructions, nonterminal visit and at least two hours before start; repository transaction/version support required
effect: Source boundary can save next care version with requiresAcknowledgement plus optional audit/outbox/replay via injected ports; full current-snapshot update integration remains pending
alternative: Late change is rejected, not automatically applied to next visit; stale version conflicts. Adapter, snapshot propagation, notification and assignee acknowledgement linkage remain implementation gates

title: Confirm Handover
requirement: A replacement pet sitter reads the care instructions and the visit history and confirms them before starting the visit.
actor: Customer owner / Staff / Admin; replacement sitter acknowledges care separately
guard: Owner Customer or operational caller confirms; replacement assignment must be eligible, differ from current sitter and acknowledge exact latest care version; current visit version required
effect: Handover service port requires atomic replacement/access capability/CONFIRMED result with optional audit/outbox/replay; full composed runtime remains pending
alternative: Unacknowledged/stale/revoked replacement fails; replacement sitter cannot call confirm solely by PET_SITTER role in current service. Do not invent self-confirm authorization

title: Check In
requirement: The pet sitter records arriving at the customer's home with a photo taken on the phone, from 30 minutes before the visit starts. Only the pet sitter assigned to the visit can check in, and a replacement only after confirming the handover. The customer sees that the pet sitter has arrived.
guard: Assigned ACTIVE sitter/current visit version, accepted handover, start-minus30-minutes through endAt, PREPAY exact verified receipt where required, owned unique READY CHECK_IN photo
effect: Transaction binds photo once, CASes visit IN_PROGRESS/checkInAt, touches booking, writes source event/Customer notification and command replay result
alternative: No careAcknowledgement hash check exists in this check-in command; treat that SRS condition as remaining gap. Reused/unowned photo, stale version, missing receipt or time violation rejects

title: Check Out
requirement: The pet sitter records leaving with a photo, after every required checklist item is done or skipped with a reason. The visit becomes Finished and the care report is sent to the customer. A visit not checked out 2 hours after its end goes to Staff, who close it with a reason; it counts as done only if it has a check-in photo.
guard: Assigned active sitter/current version, IN_PROGRESS with check-in, <=endAt+2h, complete required checklist and unique owned READY checkout evidence
effect: Transaction completes visit; only when all authoritative care visits finish, completes booking and records immutable employee service credits plus BookingCompleted event; always records visit notification/command
alternative: No automatic payout or legacy accrual task in EMPLOYEE mode. Incomplete checklist/media/CAS failure rolls back; late Staff closure and real customer report delivery remain separate acceptance

title: Complete Visit Checklist
requirement: The pet sitter ticks the care checklist (food, water, litter, play) and adds notes and at least one photo. If no photo can be uploaded, the pet sitter gives a reason instead and Staff see that the visit has no photo. The pet sitter cannot check out until every required item is ticked or has a reason for being skipped.
guard: Current assigned IN_PROGRESS visit/checkInAt/version; required snapshot item IDs unique<=100 and exact input coverage, DONE or SKIPPED with reason<=1000
effect: Transaction CASes checklist/version, touches booking and stores source event/Customer notification/command result
alternative: Unknown/duplicate/missing item or missing skipped reason rejects. This DTO has no report photo/general notes/photo-waiver field; those SRS details remain outside this endpoint

title: View Care Report
requirement: The customer or Staff reads the report of a visit with the checklist and photos.
guard: CUSTOMER owns parent booking or STAFF authorized scope; validate visit/report identity and publication/ready state
effect: Proposed care report DTO with ready/pending state
alternative: No current Customer/Staff report route established; pending until composed; cross-owner ->404; absent/incomplete evidence ->explicit pending AssignedCare.get is sitter-only and provides owner-declared care instructions, not a Customer report read. A tip for a booking done by several pet sitters is shared equally among those who did the work. The bill is shown in the app and also emailed when the customer has an email. The system checks the payOS webhook and records the payment only once. While a complaint or an incident about the booking is open, and until its result is final (the customer has 72 hours to disagree), the bill waits. alternative: Policy/retention adapters gated; no guessed deadline or change-of-mind return; duplicate/exhausted source conflicts

title: Handle Faulty Product Claim
feature: FE-23 Online Product Orders and Delivery
requirement: The Sale Staff member checks the claim and the Admin approves an exchange for the same product (new goods sent, stock goes down) or a refund paid outside the system. Faulty goods are not added back to stock, so no stock adjustment is made for them.
guard: Separate Staff review and current Admin decision, actual source/evidence, expected versions and approved policy
effect: Separate decision then evidenced exchange or external-refund resolution; faulty units never restock, replacement stock once
alternative: Uncertain external refund remains approved/unresolved for reconciliation; no fabricated UNKNOWN claim state or blind second transfer

title: View Sale Staff Dashboard
feature: FE-23 Online Product Orders and Delivery
requirement: The Sale Staff member opens the dashboard after signing in and sees the orders to prepare, orders ready for pick-up, returned parcels, faulty product claims to check and low-stock products, each linking to its list.
guard: Role assignment/permissions must be approved and implemented first; current order/product permissions are Admin-only
effect: Proposed authorized sales workspace DTO after role/source gates pass
alternative: Current nonexistent role cannot be treated as authorized; keep DESIGN_PENDING_RUNTIME until actual role, reader and dependent schema are implemented Admin inherits no invented SALE_STAFF identity; a design page is not a mounted dashboard or approved role migration.

title: Adjust Stock
requirement: The Admin increases or decreases the stock of a product with a required reason (damaged, lost, internal use, wrong receipt). Old records are never edited and the stock cannot go below zero; a decrease cannot be more than the quantity available. This is not a stock count.
guard: Evidenced reason/source receipt where required, safe signed delta, expected stock version and sellable capacity
effect: Atomic guarded stock/version, immutable adjustment and unique ledger event with command result
alternative: No unexplained positive stock; insufficiency/version/identity conflict rolls back; no historical receipt mutation
